page.overview:
Who is Ice Cream Soldier?

It is not usual that a G.I. Joe's code name is made fun of but it's not something that bothers Ice Cream Soldier. The enemy thinks it's an entire joke until he actually shows up in their doorstep and brandishes his combo weapon of flamethrower and rocket launcher and changes their perception of him. It's not only the enemy who makes fun of his code name but it's something he doesn't mind as it lets everyone underestimate him. And then he gets to show them what he can really do.
